summary: Australian Oilseeds Holdings Ltd (the registrant) filed a Form 6-K on July 28, 2026, reporting its entry into a Share Purchase Agreement on July 27, 2026, to sell all shares of subsidiary Australian Oilseeds Investments Pty Ltd and its subsidiaries (the Target Group) to Trusha Realty Pte. Ltd. Consideration is US$1.00 plus the purchaser's assumption of all Target Group liabilities and release of guarantees, based on an independent valuation citing negative net worth and operating losses. The board determined the business non-core after a strategic review. Closing occurred on July 27, 2026, subject to customary conditions. Watch for any post-closing adjustments or indemnification claims given the nominal price and liability assumption.
